issues.description: The string "python:3.12" is defined as the default in three places with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE is declared in backend/kale/pipeline.py, hardcoded as a fallback in labextension/src/lib/Commands.ts (getDefaultBaseImage catch branch), and redeclared as an exported constant in CellMetadataEditor.tsx. The postcondition "the displayed default equals the compiled default" is not provable: any one of the three may drift. REFUSED until a single authoritative source exists.

issues.description: Semantic change to _set_base_image is not reasoned about; prior behavior delegated to KFP, new behavior overrides it unconditionally.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = "" deferred to KFP's own default. Now it is set to "python:3.12" whenever pod inspection fails. The precondition ("pod metadata unavailable") and the postcondition ("pipeline still runs with whatever the user expected") were not stated. This silently changes runtime image selection for every failing-pod path. TESTED-NOT-PROVED at best.

issues.description: The Input label was visible; the replacement Button labeled "IMAGE" hides state behind a modal with no indication of current value.
issues.detail: Invariant violated: the user could previously read the current base image from the panel. Now the only way to know which image a step uses is to open the dialog. This is a regression in observable state for the sake of a default-display feature whose stated goal was more transparency, not less.

issues.description: createBaseImageText now always renders, breaking the prior invariant that absence of metadata produced no element.
issues.detail:
The function previously returned '' when no baseImage was set. It now always returns a

. Callers that relied on the empty-string sentinel (e.g., layout flow, conditional spacing) are not audited. The change of return type from string-or-element to always-element is an unstated frame change.

issues.description: DefaultState.defaultBaseImage = '' is a smuggled sentinel meaning "not yet loaded".
issues.detail: Three states are now conflated into one string field: not-loaded (''), loaded-as-default ('python:3.12'), and loaded-as-something-else. Children must use truthy-fallback chains (defaultBaseImage || DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE) to recover. This is the flag-as-goto pattern: control flow encoded in a value rather than a type. A discriminated union or null would make the invariant explicit.

issues.description: Button style width: '5%' inside a div with no width context; magic number without a stated invariant.
issues.detail: The replaced Input had width 25%; the wrapper div now has no width and the Button has 5%. There is no reasoning given for why 5% of an unspecified container is the correct size. Likely visual bug on narrow panels; at minimum, unreasoned.

review.summary: The patch introduces a useful idea — surface the default base image — but executes it without discipline. The constant "python:3.12" is now hardcoded in three places (Python pipeline, TS Commands fallback, TS editor module) with no mechanism guaranteeing they agree; the postcondition "displayed default equals compiled default" is not provable. The change to _set_base_image silently rewrites behavior on the pod-inspection-failure path without a stated precondition. The UI regresses observable state by hiding the current image behind a modal labeled "IMAGE". REFUSED pending consolidation of the default to a single source and an explicit specification of the new fallback semantics.
